name: Thread Jab
description: Jab at the point where the foe's next move is thinnest so the blow lands as they shift their weight.

name: Loose Strand
description: Tug the strand of an incoming blow a hand's width aside so that it passes the body.

name: Hunch Step
description: Step to the side the feeling says is safe a moment before the danger is seen.

name: Thread Reading
description: Feel the threads that run from a person to their next act and tell which one is pulled tight.

name: Lucky Guard
description: Hold the arms where the likeliest blow will fall and let chance turn the others aside.

name: Small Nudge
description: Lean the outcome of the user's next small act a little toward success by pulling its thread tight.

name: Omen Glance
description: Glance at the foe's stance and read the small sign that goes before their first move.

name: Crossed Thread
description: Cross two threads of the foe's intent so that their hand and foot disagree for a heartbeat.

name: Fortune Cover
description: Draw the odds of a clean hit down about the body so that a blow is likelier to glance than land.

name: Foreseen Step
description: Move out of the line of a strike one half breath before it begins.

name: Chance Palm
description: Strike with an open palm at the gap that the odds have left in the guard.

name: Steady Odds
description: Settle the nerves on the likeliest outcome so that the user's hands do not shake at the moment of need.

name: Lot Cast
description: Cast the whole weight of the body into one blow and trust the lot to fall on the weak point.

name: Odds Screen
description: Set a screen of shifting chance before the chest so that aimed blows slip a finger's breadth wide.

name: Thread Fray
description: Touch the foe's wrist and fray the thread of their grip so the weapon turns in the hand.

name: Fated Step
description: Take the step that the thread already shows is open and arrive where the foe did not guard.

name: Presage
description: Hold still and let the likely next minute settle in the mind as a faint picture of who will move first.

name: Probable Strike
description: Throw the blow where the foe is likeliest to be a moment from now and not where they stand.

name: Likely Parry
description: Put the forearm where the likeliest cut will pass and turn it away without sight of the blade.

name: Second Sight
description: See for an instant the shape a scene will take a few breaths on and note where danger gathers.

name: Tipped Scale
description: Tip the balance of a coming exchange a little toward the user by steadying breath and footing.

name: Narrow Miss
description: Bring down a thin veil of chance so that a blow that should have landed misses by a hair.

name: Fore Step
description: Step ahead of the foe's own step into the place they are about to leave open.
